matches.note: R2 covers frozen packs reading ACTIVE and R3 covers revoked packs that never get a REVOKED status and have no exposed reason; together they cover the computeStatus defect in both views.
R1 identifies the same impossible ACTIVE && isPaused branch, which lets PAUSED packs fall through to the green Active badge.
R7 covers the missing frozen guard in pausePackTransactional and R4 covers the missing revoked guard in extendPack.

unmatched_reported.note: new Date('YYYY-MM-DD') parses as UTC midnight while the minimum date is computed in local time, so the server can reject a valid 'tomorrow' pick, with a concrete UTC-5 repro.
The default card is saved before the charge, so a declined card stays as the default and a later successful retry skips the subscription card sync, with a concrete trigger.
The tier and coach checks run before the idempotent replay lookup, so a retry after createTier fails even though the parent was already charged.
